en: Hngh! Uh! Ah! Ahhhh! O-Ohhhhhhh!

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie was making brushstrokes against a
canvas, accentuating each with a sexy moan.

<CLT=cltMIND>She looked like a woman possessed,
as if being puppeted.
Mmmmm...
Angie...?
...Shuichi?

Are you okay? You looked like you were
hypnotized or something, I was worried.

Nyahaha, I'm okay. Atua came down from the
heavens and filled me with His holy presence.
All of my work is created in this manner.

But I'm surprised! Atua usually doesn't come
down in front of others, y'know?

Maybe Atua revealed Himself because
you're a chosen one, hm?
<CLT=cltMIND>I was chosen?
Hey, hey Shuichi. Look at this picture.
Ah, okay...

<CLT=cltMIND>I cautiously glanced at the
painting Angie had just finished...

<CLT=cltMIND>In an instant, I felt my consciousness
slip away, like a candle blown out by the wind...
<CLT=cltMIND>..........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...

Hellooooo? Shuichi, are you okay?
Are you still with me?

...Yes, sorry.
I felt like...I lost consciousness for a minute.

It's okay, I don't mind. This sorta thing
happens every now and then.
Art sure is difficult to understand...
Is this just a normal painting?
Is this the power of an Ultimate?
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltMIND>It happens every now
and then, does it?
Art sure is difficult to understand...

Nyahahahaha! That's what everyone else
says, too!

Even so, you felt it with such intensity that
you fainted. But you're okay now, right?
Yayyyyy! I'm so happy!
Is this just a normal painting?

I dunno. I just do what Atua compels me
to do.
Atua works in mysterious ways.
What...?

Nyahahahaha! It's okay.
Atua's not a scary god.
...Just don't make Him mad, okay?
Is this the power of an Ultimate?

Hmm? The power of an Ultimate?
What do you mean?
Well, your art is...not normal.

...I don't like you right now, Shuichi.
Atua is mad at you, too. Understand?
Ah!?

Never forget that Atua is always watching
you.

Still, it's rather strange that you fainted
when Atua chose you.
What exactly does "chosen" mean?
It means you were chosen!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Well, yeah.

Still, I think you're somewhat lacking. You're
not quite divine enough. Atua agrees, too.
Not divine enough?

Very well... By Atua's divine decree, your
training begins today.

<CLT=cltMIND>Grinning ear-to-ear, Angie skipped
over to me and...
Whoa!
Huhhh? Why are you running, Shuichi?

Y-You grabbed me all of a sudden...
And you tried to take my clothes off!

Of course. How else would I provide what
you're lacking?
I-I think I'm okay, thanks anyway!
Why are you afraid?
Atua and I will gently embrace you.

What does that mean?
What are you going to do...?
Huh?

I-I just wanted to talk, Angie!
Just be friends!

...Ah!
S-Sorry for yelling, I just...
I'm just worried about you.
Ah, Angie?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Angie's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie took off in a sprint, and
I couldn't catch her.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is bad...
I bet she's really mad at me...
